validate_skill: validate a skill directory by checking SKILL.md frontmatter format, required fields, and naming conventions
test_validate_skill: test the validate_skill function with a directory containing a valid SKILL.md file
review_validate_skill: review the validate_skill function to ensure it checks all required frontmatter fields and kebab-case naming
run_validate_skill: run quick_validate.py with a skill directory path to validate SKILL.md frontmatter
summarize_validate_skill: summarize what the validate_skill function checks in a SKILL.md file
